newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Lien Hoe unit in turnkey pact.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Lien Hoe unit in turnkey pact.

text.p: Lien Hoe Construction Sdn Bhd has been awarded an 86 million ringgit turnkey contract to build condominiums and townhouses in central Selangor state, the national Bernama news agency reported on Thursday.
Quoting officials at the signing ceremony, Bernama said the contract was awarded to the unit of Lien Hoe Corp Bhd by the developer of Bandar Sri Permaisuri township, Dwitasik Sdn Bhd.

Dwitasik executive director Zainal Abidin Osman was quoted by Bernama as saying that Lien Hoe Construction would build and project-manage 320 condominiums and 40 townhouses on a 3.2-hectare parcel of the integrated township.
Work on the parcel would begin in March next year and was expected to be completed within 30 months, Zainal Abidin said.
Lien Hoe Corp managing director Chan Wah Long said the company was committed to undertaking direct construction contracts worth 300 million ringgit for the next two to three years, Bernama reported.
